## 1.2
- New Stats and Hall of Fame screen with four pages: top 3 scores, your games, the computer's games and overall stats
- Scores and stats are saved on the SD card
- Hold OK on the stats screen to reset everything
- New highscore celebration
- Longer intro with sparkles at the end

## 1.1
- About screen with a QR code to the author's GitHub
- The computer now thinks for a moment before every guess
- 2 second victory celebration with confetti
- Animations: intro, sliding menu, number reel, shaking wrong guesses, cheat alarm and a flying butterfly

## 1.0
- Initial release: be the guesser or let the computer guess, custom ranges and cheat detection
